title: Implement and release supported agent lifecycle APIs
description: Implement the approved behavior specifications, update documentation, run all Tactus quality gates, and publish the next patch release for Plexus consumption.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Added failing specifications first for request-timeout propagation, no-inference prewarming, lifecycle events, and native Pydantic JSON serialization. Confirmed five expected failures, then implemented the supported APIs. Focused DSPy/JSON suite is now 312 passing; targeted Ruff passes and Black formatting is clean after one mechanical reformat. Next: full Tactus gates, review, commit, and PR/release workflow.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Implemented supported request timeouts, lifecycle telemetry, no-inference prewarming, native Pydantic JSON serialization, and canonical callable Agent documentation. Added failing specifications before implementation. Full verification passed: Ruff, Black, 4,184 unit tests passed with 73 skipped and 63 deselected, and 449 BDD scenarios passed with 5 skipped. Implementation is ready for feature-branch PR; the patch release follows merge through the repository release workflow.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Implementation and release gates are complete; feature-branch PR and automated patch publication are the remaining delivery operations.
